MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition x RRP x access x profile x texture. Coating tasks use QT x access x profile x texture. Condition and RRP NEVER apply to coating tasks. QT NEVER applies to prep tasks.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x lap(1.00) x textured(1.15) = 7.36x — extreme theoretical for pre-1978 peeling EW at scaffold height
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_prep: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x lap(1.00) x textured(1.15) = 2.33x — within cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT4(1.30) x scaffold(1.60) x lap(1.00) x textured(1.15) = 2.39x — within 4.0x cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_coating: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x lap(1.00) x textured(1.15) = 1.55x — comfortable

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x profile x texture)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x profile x texture)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment fixed tasks, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough — no modifiers applied.

siding_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net siding field area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours. RP rates calibrated from NC sibling (SF_SIDING_ENGINEERED_EXT_NC_v1) with RP-specific adjustments. Base rates are for lap profile, smooth texture, ground access. spray_backroll is PRIMARY RP method. Low-pressure power wash (500-1000 PSI) is allowed for engineered wood RP.

task_production_rates._note: Protection setup, fixture masking, vehicle protection, equipment staging

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_LANDSCAPE_PROTECT (NC 120 LF/hr). Ground-level task. Deploy tarps along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent. ~30 sec per LF. RP adds scraping debris and wash water runoff containment.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_HARDSCAPE_PROTECT (NC 250 SF/hr). Ground-level task. Lay drop cloths and plastic on flat walkway/patio surfaces. ~14 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Fixture and Utility Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_FIXTURE_MASK (NC 15 EA/hr). Bag and tape light fixtures, utility panels, hose bibs. ~4 min per fixture. HVAC units take longer (~10 min). RP: all fixtures installed and operational — masking mandatory.

task_production_rates.name: Extended Landscape Overspray Protection (Spray Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Extended overspray protection for landscape areas beyond perimeter edge tarps. ~18 sec per SF. Ground-level task. spray_backroll only. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_LANDSCAPE_FULL_PROTECT (200 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Deploy poly sheeting and drop cloths over vehicles, driveway surfaces. RP-specific — occupied home context. ~18 sec per SF. Ground-level task. spray_backroll only. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_VEHICLE_PROTECT (200 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: Spray/Backroll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY (NC 50 min includes spray_backroll staging). RP uses same 50 min — airless sprayer config + backroll equipment staging (18-inch frame, roller covers). Per-session FIXED time. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY_BACKROLL (50 min).

task_production_rates.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_BRUSH (NC 20 min). Per-session FIXED time. Stage brushes, rollers, trays, extension poles. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_BRUSH_ROLL (20 min).

task_production_rates._note: RP-specific condition assessment. All RP_NEW. FIXED per-elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Inspection Per Elevation

QT2.notes: Quick ground-level scan. Note obvious defects. ~10 min per elevation.

QT3.notes: Standard visual with work light, document visible defects per elevation. ~15 min.

QT4.notes: Systematic scan with raking light, photograph all defect areas, per-elevation assessment. ~20 min.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Maps cracking, peeling, chalking, fading, edge swelling. Assigns substrate state. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_ASSESS_CONDITION (same QT rates). EW adds edge seal assessment scope vs FC.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Test)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Cross-hatch tape test at minimum 2 locations per elevation. ~10 min. Pass + SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT = skip full prime. Fail = full prime required. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_ASSESS_ADHESION (10 min).

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Test (White Cloth Rub)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Rub clean white cloth across painted siding at 2-3 representative locations per elevation. ~5 min. Moderate/heavy chalk triggers SS_EXT_CHALKING and chalk-binding primer path. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_ASSESS_CHALK (5 min).

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Probe at Joints and Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Pin-type moisture meter at siding-to-trim junctions, butt joints, cut edges, and water damage areas. ~10 min per elevation. MC >15% = STOP WORK for coating. EW is more moisture-sensitive than FC. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_ASSESS_MOISTURE (10 min).

task_production_rates.name: Edge Seal Integrity Check
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. EW-specific assessment — no FC or wood siding equivalent. Inspect all visible cut edges at butt joints, miters, and field cuts for swelling, springback, soft spots. Probe with utility knife at suspect areas. ~10 min per elevation. Replaces NC TSK_ENSD_SEAL_CUT_EDGES (application → assessment).

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' Protocol

QT2.notes: Quick scan of major joints — note obvious failures. ~10 min per elevation.

QT3.notes: Comprehensive assessment of all joint types. Document LF requiring replacement. ~15 min.

QT4.notes: Critical assessment of every joint. Full LF documentation with defect photographs. ~20 min.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Assess all joint types: siding-to-trim, butt joints, foundation transitions. Butt joints assessed but NOT re-caulked per NC moisture trap prohibition. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_ASSESS_CAULK (same QT rates). EW has fewer caulk joints than FC overall but butt joint assessment is EW-specific concern.

task_production_rates._note: Condition-driven prep. Prep pool modifiers: condition x RRP x access x profile x texture.

task_production_rates.name: Low-Pressure Power Wash (500-1000 PSI)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE (NC 600 SF/hr garden hose). RP upgrades to low-pressure power wash (500-1000 PSI) — ~33% faster than garden hose = 800 SF/hr (~4.5 sec per SF). KEY DEPARTURE: EW allows power wash at 500-1000 PSI (NC prohibits power washing, FC RP prohibits power washing). CRITICAL: never exceed 1000 PSI — damages OSB core at joints/cut edges. 24-48 hr dry time before coating. TSP at QT4. Condition modifier applies (POOR has more stubborn contamination). No profile/texture modifiers — wash rate is constant. No RRP modifier — washing is cleaning, not paint disturbance.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Algae Biocide Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Apply biocide solution to mildew/algae areas. 10-15 min dwell. Rinse with low-pressure water. ~18 sec per SF. Common on north-facing/shaded elevations. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_MILDEW_TREAT (200 SF/hr). Condition modifier applies (FAIR/POOR have more extensive growth). No RRP modifier — biocide is cleaning, not paint disturbance. No profile/texture modifiers — biocide application rate is constant.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Failing/Peeling Paint + Feather Sand Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Carbide scraper to remove failing/peeling paint to sound substrate. 80-100 grit feather-edge sanding mandatory on ALL scraped transitions. QT3 baseline: 55 SF/hr (~65 sec/SF). Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER (QT3: 50 SF/hr); EW is slightly faster — no cementitious hardness, softer substrate, but same feathering requirement. Condition modifier: FAIR=1.5x (light scraping), POOR=2.0x (heavy scraping). RRP 2.0x for wet scraping method. Profile modifier applies (panel 0.90x — large flat areas faster to scrape).

task_production_rates.name: Degloss/Scuff Existing Sound Paint
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_SCUFF_SAND (NC 200 SF/hr). Same rate — 150-180 grit scuff sand for adhesion profile. ~18 sec per SF. RP targets existing paint film adhesion (not factory primer). Chemical deglosser alternative for complex areas. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_DEGLOSS_SCUFF (QT3: 200 SF/hr). Skip for SS_EXT_PEELING (full scrape renders degloss redundant). Skip for SS_EXT_CHALKING (chalk remediation path). Profile modifier applies (panel 0.90x).

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Remediation Pre-Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Chemical chalk remover on stubborn chalking areas after power wash. Wipe and verify with white cloth test. ~18 sec per SF. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_CHALK_REMEDIATION (200 SF/hr). SS_EXT_CHALKING only. No RRP modifier — chalk remediation is cleaning, not paint disturbance. No profile/texture modifiers — chemical application rate is constant.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Failed Caulk at Joints
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Cut out failed caulk with utility knife, clean joint to bare substrate. ~2 min per LF. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_CAULK_REMOVE_FAILED (30 LF/hr). Butt joint caulk REMOVED but NOT re-caulked (moisture trap prohibition from NC). No RRP modifier — caulk removal does not disturb paint. No profile/texture modifiers — joint geometry is consistent.

task_production_rates.name: Apply New Caulk at Siding-to-Trim Joints
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_CAULK_JOINTS (NC 90 LF/hr). RP caulk goes into variable-width cleaned joints vs NC fresh uniform joints — slower at 60 LF/hr (~60 sec per LF). Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_CAULK_APPLY_NEW (QT3: 60 LF/hr). Tool smooth. Do NOT re-caulk butt joints. Allow 2-4 hr cure before overcoating. No condition modifier — caulk application rate is constant. No profile/texture modifiers — joint geometry is consistent.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Content Verification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_MOISTURE_CHECK (NC 1200 SF/hr). Same rate and threshold (<15% MC). RP checks existing paint film + edge seal areas after wash dry time. Pin-type moisture meter at cut edges, joints, and flagged areas. ~3 sec per SF average. Mandatory at ALL tiers. EW is more moisture-sensitive than FC. No condition/RRP modifiers — MC check rate is constant.

task_production_rates.name: Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_DUST_CLEANUP (NC 600 SF/hr). RP generates more debris (sanding dust + scraping debris + chalk residue + caulk debris) — reduced to 500 SF/hr (~7 sec per SF). Compressed air or tack cloth. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_PREP_DUST_DEBRIS (500 SF/hr). Access modifier applies. No condition or RRP modifiers.

task_production_rates._note: State-driven primer. Coating pool modifiers. NO alkali-resistant primer (neutral pH).

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Spray + Back-Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL (NC 175 SF/hr for 2-person crew). RP rate is FASTER at 225 SF/hr because previously painted EW surface is less porous than NC factory-primed — primer doesn't absorb as deeply. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL (265 SF/hr); EW slightly slower than FC due to lap/panel profile complexity = 225 SF/hr. Two-person operation: sprayer leads, roller follows within wet edge. Primary RP prime method. Profile modifier applies (panel 0.90x — faster). Texture modifier applies (textured 1.15x).

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 100 SF/hr). Same physical action — brush for edges, roller for field. ~36 sec per SF. Fallback method for <750 SF, occupied-adjacent, or high wind. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (100 SF/hr). Profile modifier applies. Texture modifier applies.

task_production_rates._note: Coat 1 and Coat 2 application. Coating pool modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray + Back-Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_FINISH_1_SPRAY_BACKROLL (NC 175 SF/hr for 2-person crew). RP rate is FASTER at 225 SF/hr because primed/previously painted surface provides more consistent absorption than NC factory-primed. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_FINISH_1_SPRAY_BACKROLL (225 SF/hr). Two-person operation: sprayer leads, roller follows. Primary RP finish method. ~16 sec per SF combined. Profile modifier applies (panel 0.90x). Texture modifier applies (textured 1.15x).

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_FINISH_1_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 100 SF/hr). Same physical action — brush for edges, roller for field. ~36 sec per SF. Fallback method. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_FINISH_1_BRUSH_ROLL (100 SF/hr). Profile modifier applies. Texture modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray + Back-Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_FINISH_2_SPRAY_BACKROLL (NC 175 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1 spray_backroll (225 SF/hr). Consistent absorption on primed/first-coated surface. QT3/QT4 only — QT2 receives single finish coat. Final appearance coat. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_FINISH_2_SPRAY_BACKROLL (225 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_FINISH_2_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 100 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1. QT3/QT4 only. Final appearance coat. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_FINISH_2_BRUSH_ROLL (100 SF/hr).

task_production_rates._note: Between-coat inspection and maintenance. Coating pool modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Inspection

QT3.notes: Quick scan for obvious defects — runs, sags, holidays. ~2.4 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Systematic inspection at 6 ft viewing distance. Mark all visible defects. ~4.5 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_INSPECT_COAT (NC QT3: 1500, QT4: 800 SF/hr). Identical inspection process once first coat applied. QT3/QT4 only — QT2 is single coat. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_INSPECT_COAT. No profile/texture modifiers — inspection rate is visual scanning, constant across profiles.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Light Sand (QT4 Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_SAND_BETWEEN (NC 300 SF/hr). 220 grit light scuff between finish coats. ~12 sec per SF. QT4 only. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_SAND_BETWEEN (300 SF/hr). Profile modifier applies (panel 0.90x). No texture modifier — sanding rate on cured finish coat is constant.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Touch-Up

QT3.notes: Fix obvious defects — minimal touch-up. ~1.8 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Fix all found defects. Blend repairs. ~3.6 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_TOUCHUP_REPAIR (NC QT3: 2000, QT4: 1000 SF/hr). Identical brush touch-up process. QT3/QT4 only. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_TOUCHUP_REPAIR. No profile/texture modifiers — touch-up is spot brush work at constant rate.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Dust Removal (QT4 Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_DUST_INTERCOAT (NC 600 SF/hr). Tack cloth or compressed air after interstage sanding. ~6 sec per SF. QT4 only (paired with TSK_EWRP_SAND_BETWEEN). Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_DUST_INTERCOAT (600 SF/hr). No profile/texture modifiers.

task_production_rates._note: Final inspection, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, customer walkthrough.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection

QT2.notes: Ground-level walkthrough. Quick scan for misses. ~1.8 sec/SF.

QT3.notes: Ground-level walkthrough at 6-10 ft. Check all elevations. Verify caulk joints covered. ~3 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Ground-level with binoculars for upper elevations. 6 ft viewing standard. ~7.2 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_FINAL_INSPECT (NC QT2: 2000, QT3: 1200, QT4: 500 SF/hr). Identical inspection process. RP addition: verify caulk joints covered and consistent. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_FINAL_INSPECT. No profile/texture modifiers — visual scanning from ground.

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up

QT2.notes: Minimal touch-up. Fix obvious misses only. ~1.2 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Fix every defect. Blend seamlessly at 3 ft standard. ~6 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_FINAL_TOUCHUP (NC QT2: 3000, QT3: 1500, QT4: 600 SF/hr). Identical brush touch-up. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_FINAL_TOUCHUP. No profile/texture modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_ENSD_PROTECT_TEARDOWN (NC 200 LF/hr). Remove all tarps, plastic, tape, fixture bags, HVAC covers along perimeter. ~18 sec per LF. Faster than setup — pull and fold vs stake and secure. Ground-level task. No modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Equipment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_CLEAN_EQUIPMENT (NC 35 min). Same time — NC already includes backroll cleanup. RP confirmed 35 min: full flush cycle for sprayer + clean 18-inch roller frames and dispose saturated covers. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_CLEAN_EQUIPMENT (35 min). No modifiers on FIXED tasks.

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_SITE_CLEANUP (NC 20 min). RP adds 5 min (25 min total) — scraping debris, caulk tubes, biocide containers, chalk remover, extra masking tape, poly sheeting. Matches FC RP TSK_FCRP_SITE_CLEANUP (25 min). No modifiers on FIXED tasks.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough (RP-Specific)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-project FIXED time. Walk each elevation with homeowner, verify color/sheen satisfaction, point out areas of concern, document completion sign-off. RP-specific — occupied home context. Calibrated from FC RP TSK_FCRP_CUSTOMER_WALKTHROUGH (15 min). No modifiers on FIXED tasks.

task_production_rates._note: Lead-safe RRP module. Shared across all exterior RP specs. Conditional on pre_1978 + lead.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Screening Test (XRF or Swab)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Per-elevation FIXED time. XRF preferred; lead swab test acceptable. Test minimum 2 locations per elevation. Results gate subsequent RRP tasks and 2.0x prep modifier (FAC_EWRP_RRP). LP SmartSide entered market late 1990s — material is post-1978, but building structure may be pre-1978. Calibrated from FC RP (15 min).

task_production_rates.name: RRP Exterior Containment Setup (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Per-elevation FIXED time. Install 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure per EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. Secure edges with weights/stakes. Install warning signage. Calibrated from FC RP (45 min). No modifiers on per-elevation FIXED tasks.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Wet Scraping Method
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Wet-mist surface before scraping to minimize lead dust. All scraping debris into containment. ~72 sec per SF. Condition modifier applies. This task's time is ALREADY captured in the 2.0x RRP modifier on TSK_EWRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER — do NOT double-count. Task exists for RRP documentation and lead-safe work practice tracking. Calibrated from FC RP (50 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. HEPA vacuum all siding surfaces after sanding/scraping. ~12 sec per SF. Required by EPA RRP Rule after EVERY paint disturbance. Access modifier applies. Calibrated from FC RP (300 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: RRP Exterior Containment Teardown (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Per-elevation FIXED time. Remove containment poly — fold inward to capture debris, bag for lead-safe disposal. Verify cleaning standard per EPA. Calibrated from FC RP (35 min). No modifiers on per-elevation FIXED tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Scale Prep Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Overall coating condition drives prep intensity. GOOD = minimal prep, FAIR = moderate (15-30% failing), POOR = extensive (40-60%+ failing). Applies to prep tasks ONLY — never coating tasks.
factor_modifiers.notes: Same pattern as FC RP FAC_CONDITION_SCALE. GOOD maps to SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, FAIR maps to SS_EXT_CHALKING or localized SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, POOR maps to SS_EXT_PEELING or widespread SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT.

factor_modifiers.name: EPA Lead-Safe RRP Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Binary gate for pre-1978 + lead-positive. Doubles prep time for EPA-compliant wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment procedures.
factor_modifiers.notes: Only applies to tasks that disturb existing paint. Washing, chalk remediation, mildew treatment, caulk removal are cleaning — not paint disturbance — and NOT subject to RRP modifier.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Height Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access type drives production rate reduction for elevated work. Per-elevation attribute. Same as NC FAC_EXT_ACCESS.
factor_modifiers.notes: Ground-level tasks (protection setup/teardown, equipment setup/cleanup, site cleanup, customer walkthrough, assessment FIXED tasks) are NOT affected.

factor_modifiers.name: Siding Profile Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Siding profile affects application and prep rates. Panel is slightly FASTER than lap in RP (large flat areas efficient for spray_backroll). NO T1-11 in RP.
factor_modifiers.notes: Panel is 0.90x (FASTER) in RP — spray_backroll on large flat areas is efficient. NC panel was 1.10x (slower) because spray-only on large flats requires overlap management. RP panel follows FC RP pattern.

factor_modifiers.name: Surface Texture Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Surface texture affects coating application rates and material consumption. 2 textures: smooth/textured. Existing paint film moderates original texture differences.
factor_modifiers.notes: Applies to BOTH production rate and material quantity (see coverage_profiles in materials.json). 'Textured' combines NC cedarmill (1.20x) and roughsawn (1.30x) into single 1.15x — existing paint film moderates the difference.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Coating Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Quality tier drives coating task production rate. QT2 is slightly faster (economy standard), QT4 is slower (premium detail). Applies to coating tasks ONLY — never prep tasks.
factor_modifiers.notes: Same pattern as FC RP. QT2 = economy (faster application, lower standard). QT3 = standard baseline. QT4 = premium (slower, more care). Never applies to prep tasks.

quality_effects.notes: Economy tier. Single finish coat. Skip interstage module. Minimal inspection. LP warranty requires 2 coats — QT2 accepts the trade-off. Prime only if substrate state requires it.
Standard tier. Two finish coats per LP SmartSide warranty. Interstage inspection but no sanding. Full assessment scope. Prime only if substrate state requires it.
Premium tier. Two finish coats. Light 220 grit sand between coats. Systematic inspection at 6 ft. TSP wash. Full assessment with photography.

prep_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x profile x texture)

coating_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x profile x texture)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough — no modifiers.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Lap siding, smooth, ground access — baseline (spray_backroll finish)
Lap siding, textured, ladder access — common residential (spray_backroll finish QT3)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Typical residential scenario. ~145 SF/hr per 2-person crew.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Panel siding, smooth, ground access — fastest (spray_backroll finish QT2)
Lap siding, textured, scaffold — worst case coating (spray_backroll finish QT4)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Worst case coating. ~94 SF/hr per 2-person crew. Well within 4.0x cap.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Lap siding, textured, scaffold, POOR, RRP — worst case prep (scrape/feather)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Extreme worst case prep. ~9 SF/hr. Exceeds 4.0x cap but prep pool worst-case is acknowledged. This scenario is pre-1978 peeling EW at scaffold height — legitimately very slow and rare.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Lap siding, smooth, ladder, FAIR, no RRP — realistic worst prep (scrape/feather)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Realistic worst prep. ~27 SF/hr. Within cap.

assumptions: Base rates are for lap siding profile at ground access on smooth surface.
Profile, texture, access, and pool-specific modifiers stack multiplicatively: effective_rate = base_rate / (combined_modifier).
Prep pool worst case can exceed 4.0x cap — acknowledged for pre-1978 RRP on POOR condition siding at scaffold height.
Coating pool worst case is 2.39x — well within 4.0x cap.
spray_backroll tasks are single combined tasks (2-person crew: sprayer leads, backroller follows).
RP spray_backroll rates (225 SF/hr) are FASTER than NC spray_backroll rates (175 SF/hr) because previously painted surface provides more consistent absorption.
RP brush_roll rates (100 SF/hr) are identical to NC — same physical action.
Assessment FIXED tasks are per-elevation — multiply by elevation count.
Equipment setup/cleanup are per-session FIXED tasks.
Customer walkthrough is per-project FIXED task.
Power wash 500-1000 PSI is EW-specific — FC RP uses garden hose rinse only.
Environmental conditions (wind, dew point, sun, surface temp) are NOT estimation modifiers per RC-002.
RRP modifier applies to paint disturbance tasks ONLY (scraping, sanding), not cleaning tasks.
risks: Pre-1978 RRP + POOR condition + scaffold = 6.40x stacking on scrape/feather — flag for estimator review.
spray_backroll 2-person crew requirement doubles labor cost on prime and finish tasks.
Power wash PSI must be carefully controlled — exceeding 1000 PSI damages OSB core irreversibly.
Edge seal assessment is qualitative — estimator must judge repair scope from assessment results.
Condition scale mapping (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) is subjective — visual assessment + adhesion test + chalk test reduce subjectivity but cannot eliminate it.
